name: Dashtestan
overview: The TV series Dashtestan depicts the comedic story of three young students, Ghafoor, Farid, and Danial, who share a dormitory. However, their friendship enters a new phase with the arrival of three new students, Khosrow, Nemat, and Amin, and unexpected adventures unfold for them. These 6 people are then forced to rent a room after the dormitory capacity is reached, and their fates become intertwined.
